person.name: Lucinda Harrowgate
person.target_direction: District / multi-unit manager, or store manager at a larger-volume store

roles.title: Store Manager (Store #212)
roles.context: Big-box home goods store, 38,000 sq ft. Annual sales about $14.5M (FY2024). 62 associates (about 20 full-time), 3 assistant store managers and 5 department leads. Owns store-level four-wall P&L lines she can control: payroll (about 9.5% of sales), shrink, supplies, and sales. Systems: Oracle Retail POS, Kronos/UKG Workforce scheduling, Reflexis task management.

accomplishments.title: Shrink reduction
accomplishments.problem: Store shrink was 2.9% of sales at the 2019 physical inventory, among the worst in the 14-store district; mostly paperwork/receiving errors plus organized retail theft in small electrics and bedding.
accomplishments.actions: Retrained receiving on vendor direct-store-delivery check-in, started weekly audit of damaged/RTV logs, moved high-theft SKUs to locked fixtures and front endcaps with the district LP manager, and added shrink results to associate huddles.
accomplishments.results: Shrink fell from 2.9% (2019) to 1.4% at the FY2024 physical inventory, roughly $215K per year at current sales volume.

accomplishments.title: Associate turnover reduction
accomplishments.problem: Annualized hourly turnover was 78% and the store was constantly short-staffed and spending managers' time on hiring.
accomplishments.actions: Rebuilt the first-two-weeks onboarding (buddy, checklists, 30-day check-in), posted schedules 3 weeks out instead of 1 week in UKG, and created a cross-training path so part-timers could pick up more hours.

accomplishments.title: Comparable sales growth above district
accomplishments.problem: Store had been flat-to-negative comp for three years before she arrived.
accomplishments.actions: Focused department leads on in-stock and recovery standards by 10am, rolled out associate add-on selling for bedding and window treatments, and reset seasonal layout to company planogram on time.
accomplishments.results: FY2024 comp sales +6.8% versus district average +2.1%; store ranked #2 of 14 in the district for FY2024.

accomplishments.title: Freight processing workflow
accomplishments.problem: Truck freight often sat in the stockroom and was still being worked on the floor in the afternoon, blocking aisles during peak shopping and causing out-of-stocks.
accomplishments.actions: Moved the freight team start time to 5am, set up sort-by-department pallet staging and a zone-based putaway routine.
accomplishments.results: She says freight used to be finished around 2pm and is now done by about 10am, with 3 trucks per week. No formal tracking.

accomplishments.title: Developing associates into management
accomplishments.problem: Store relied on external hires for department leads and ASMs.
accomplishments.actions: Created an informal leadership development program (shadow shifts, key holder training, quarterly development conversations).
accomplishments.results: Promoted 4 associates to department lead and 2 department leads to assistant store manager since 2019; one ASM later became a store manager in another district.

accomplishments.title: Curbside pickup launch during 2020 closures
accomplishments.problem: In spring 2020 the store was closed to in-person shopping and company launched curbside pickup with one week's notice.
accomplishments.actions: Reorganized the front of store into a BOPIS staging area, redeployed associates to picking, and set up a phone queue for customers.
accomplishments.results: Qualitative: kept all full-time associates working through the closure; district manager used her staging layout as an example for other stores. No numbers kept.

roles.title: Assistant Store Manager (Store #187)
roles.context: About $11M annual sales store; responsible for operations/receiving and the back of house team of 12.

accomplishments.title: Inventory accuracy through cycle counts
accomplishments.problem: Perpetual inventory was unreliable, causing phantom on-hands and missed replenishment.
accomplishments.actions: Set up a daily cycle count routine by department and trained receiving associates on correcting on-hands.
accomplishments.results: Cycle count accuracy improved from 92% to 98% over 2017.

accomplishments.title: Holiday seasonal hiring
accomplishments.problem: Store needed to staff up quickly every Q4.
accomplishments.actions: Ran hiring events and seasonal onboarding.
accomplishments.results: Hired and onboarded about 25 seasonal associates each holiday season (2016-2018).

roles.title: Department Supervisor, Footwear & Apparel
roles.context: Sporting goods store; supervised a team of 8 associates.

accomplishments.title: Footwear fitting service
accomplishments.problem: Running shoe sales were losing to specialty stores.
accomplishments.actions: Trained her team on gait-based fitting and product knowledge from vendor reps.
accomplishments.results: Qualitative: department earned a regional customer service award in 2014; no sales data retained.

accomplishments.title: Promotion to department supervisor
accomplishments.actions: Became key holder in year one, consistently top seller of protection plans on her shift.
accomplishments.results: Promoted to department supervisor after 21 months.
